description: For a business identifier you give (for example a Belgian company number or a Peppol ID such as 0208:0521875440), find the access-point provider that receives its e-invoices on the Peppol network: provider organisation, SMP host, document types, certificate validity. Provider metadata only. Limited per day; when the limit is reached the answer points to the free lookup on the website. Country is an optional two-letter hint.
name: lookup_access_point
title: Which provider receives a company's e-invoices?
